---
title: "PSY221A: Correlation and ANOVA"
output: html_document
---

```{r load data}

h1Data <- read.csv("Data/processed/h1.csv")
h2Data <- read.csv("Data/processed/h2.csv")

# Check the variable types, missing values, and group sizes.
str(h1Data)
str(h2Data)
table(h1Data$politics)

```

```{r correlations}

cor(h2Data$financialProspects,h2Data$freeTime)

cor.test(h2Data$financialProspects,h2Data$freeTime)

```

```{r anova}

by(h1Data$jealousy, h1Data$politics, mean)

h1Anova <- aov(jealousy ~ politics, data = h1Data)
summary(h1Anova)

```

```{rpost_hoc}

TukeyHSD(h1Anova)}

```
